name: @8bitscript/color
description: A whole-frame flicker blend between two of a machine's fixed palette colors — the C64 demoscene's "more than 16 colours" trick, riding on @8bitscript/raster's own list. Resolves per target to that machine's own color implementation; #fact(video.colorBlend) says whether the machine has one at all. Scoped for now to the project's five release targets (docs/roadmap.md); the rest of the catalog is unaffected.
